title: fix(spec, objectql, driver-sql): a predicate delete with a cascade locks the rows it walks
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9UbesJS6dTPnENK2P5ytLpg)_

Fixes #34373

Clause-②: yes (widening: DriverOptions.lockRows and DriverCapabilities.lockRows)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — a driver capability and an engine→driver option; no skill teaches DriverOptions or DriverCapabilities

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：带级联的谓词删除（`delete(obj, { where, multi: true })`）在删除事务里先给命中的行加锁再删；SQL 驱动声明新能力位 `lockRows`，`find()` 在事务内发 `FOR UPDATE`。
- 为什么改：原先先读命中 id、走级联、再按 id 删，调用方的条件（如「只删仍是 pending 的」）不在最终 DELETE 上；并发提交把行改出条件后，这行照样被删、还被计数。
- 风险与回滚：只有声明 `lockRows` 的驱动在事务内才加锁，其它驱动和 `split` 计划行为不变；回滚即回退本 PR，spec 只多两个可选键。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts` 的级联分支（约 750–775 行）和 `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-crud.ts` 的 `lockRowsIfAsked`。
- 两分钟验证：设好 `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` 后跑 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-34373-lock-rows.test.ts`，看两种并发次序都不会删掉被改出条件的行。
- 需要你做的：无，等审核席复审后由席位转 ready。

## What changes

A predicate delete on an object that delete-family lookups reference reads the matched ids, walks the cascade, then deletes those rows by `id $in`, so the caller's predicate is not on the final DELETE. A concurrent commit between the read and the delete that moved a row out of the predicate (`{ id, source: 'idp_pending' }` → `active`) was deleted anyway, and counted.

- **spec** (`packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts`):
  - `DriverOptions.lockRows` (hunk `@@ -113,0 +114,23 @@`, after `bypassTenantAudit`): on a `find()` inside a `transaction`, lock the returned rows until the transaction ends.
  - `DriverCapabilities.lockRows` (hunk `@@ -340,0 +367,35 @@`, after `aggregationFilter`) and its header bullet (hunk `@@ -162,0 +186,3 @@`): the driver's `find()` honours that option; absence = `false`.
  - **Precedent**: the bit follows `aggregationFilter` — `packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts:339` on main, read by the engine at `packages/objectql/src/engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts:1443` (`drv?.supports?.aggregationFilter === true`), changeset `.changeset/33698-measure-filter-pushdown.md`: one optional capability bit, landed together with its engine reader, absence = the engine keeps its own path.
  - Collision note: #33876 also adds a `DriverCapabilities` bit next to `aggregationFilter`. The hunk at `+367` is the one that meets it; the `DriverOptions` hunk and the header bullet are independent.
- **objectql** (`engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`, the cascade arm of `runPredicateDelete`): when the unit has a transaction handle and the driver declares `supports.lockRows`, the matched-row read carries `lockRows: true`. Rows deleted are still exactly the rows walked.
- **objectql refusal** (`engine-driver-options.ts` `buildDriverOptions`, new `lock-rows-refusal-error.ts`, `engine.ts` host gets `getDriver`): `lockRows` arriving at the engine→driver hop from any option bag is refused before a driver runs — `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` / 501 when the object's driver does not declare the bit, `PRECONDITION_REQUIRED` / 428 when no transaction reaches that driver. A lock request is never dropped silently. The read and delete verbs already refuse `lockRows` from a caller as an unknown option (`rejectUnknownEngineOptions`), unchanged.
- **driver-sql** (`sql-driver-crud.ts` `lockRowsIfAsked`, `sql-driver.ts` `supports.lockRows: true`): `find()`/`findOne()` add `forUpdate()` (PG/MySQL/Oracle `FOR UPDATE`, MSSQL `UPDLOCK`, SQLite nothing — the database lock keeps the promise, see Verification). `lockRows` without a transaction → `PRECONDITION_REQUIRED` / 428.

What keeps the window: a driver without the bit (memory, MongoDB, OData), and a cascade that cannot run in one transaction (`split` plan, no transactions).

## Tests

- New `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-34373-lock-rows.test.ts`: the 428 refusal; live PG/MySQL row-lock cells (writer after the locked read waits; locked read behind a writer waits and does not return the moved row); SQLite two-connection pins for WAL (`SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT` on the transaction's delete, row kept as moved) and rollback journal (writer `SQLITE_BUSY`, delete stands).
- New `describe('[#34373] …')` in `packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-delete-atomic.test.ts`: locked read with the bit; none without the bit or without transactions; the verbs' existing refusal of `lockRows`; 501 and 428 with code + status; the in-transaction pass.
- Tests changed:
  - `packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-delete-atomic.test.ts` — the shared harness `makeDriver` takes `{ transactional, lockRows }` and records a `reads` ledger; existing cases unchanged.
  - `packages/spec/src/data/driver.test.ts` — `LIVE_BITS` gains `lockRows`; the shape pin renamed to `6 live bits + 31 tombstones`; accept/refuse cases for both keys.

## Acceptance notes

The card's scenario (guarded predicate delete vs a concurrent move) is read end to end below against live PostgreSQL 16, at head and with the lock stripped.

Review follow-ups (contract review 6933706748 nits N1–N3 and the PostgreSQL UPDATE-privilege note): filed #34549.

## Verification

All readings on a shared cloud box; heavy runs under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. Live PostgreSQL 16 local (`OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL`), server zone `Asia/Shanghai`, process `TZ=America/New_York` for the full driver-sql suite (its timezone fixtures require both skews). MySQL, SQL Server and Oracle were **not** measured here; `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` runs the live cells on main's full battery; it is skipped on this pull request by its own `if:`, so no check-run on this PR executes the live PostgreSQL or MySQL lock cells — the PostgreSQL reading here is local.

<details><summary>Suites</summary>

- `@objectstack/spec` vitest: 937 files, 28629 passed, 1 todo.
- `@objectstack/objectql` vitest: 605 files, 13516 passed.
- `@objectstack/driver-sql` vitest (live PG + SQLite): 267 files passed, 4 skipped; 5459 passed, 128 skipped (MySQL / MSSQL cells NOT RUN).
- `sql-driver-34373-lock-rows.test.ts`: 7 passed, 1 skipped (MySQL cell).
- `tsc --noEmit` for spec, objectql, driver-sql: clean. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 14/14 current after the docs regeneration.
</details>

<details><summary>End to end: ObjectQL engine + SqlDriver on live PostgreSQL</summary>

A temporary test (not committed) booted `ObjectQL` with a real `SqlDriver`, a `ticket` object and a `master_detail` `note` child (so the delete takes the cascade arm), inserted one `pending` ticket with one note, and wrapped `find` so that right after the delete's matched-row read a second driver (its own pool) runs `update(ticket, { status: 'active' })` and is given 400 ms. Then `engine.delete('ticket', { where: { status: 'pending' }, multi: true })`.

| run | lock requested | writer committed before the delete | removed | row after |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| head | yes | **no** (waited on the row lock) | 1 | gone (deleted while still `pending`; the move then found nothing) |
| lock stripped before the driver | — | **yes** (`active` committed) | 1 | gone: **the `active` row was deleted** — the card's defect |
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation readings (each restored, tree clean after)</summary>

- A1 `sql-driver-crud.ts` `return builder.forUpdate();` → `return builder;`: both live-PG row-lock pins red.
- A2 `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts` `{ ...writeOptions, lockRows: true }` → `writeOptions`: "reads the matched rows with lockRows …" red (1 of 27).
- A3 the `engine-driver-options.ts` refusal guard disabled: the 501 and 428 pins red (2 of 27).
- A4 `sql-driver-crud.ts` `if (!options.transaction)` → `if (false)`: "answers PRECONDITION_REQUIRED / 428" red.
</details>

<details><summary>SQLite, two connections on one file (measured)</summary>

- WAL (the file default `connect()` applies): the other connection's update commits; the transaction's own `deleteMany` fails `SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT`; after rollback the row is `active` (not deleted).
- Rollback journal: the other connection's update fails `SQLITE_BUSY` after the busy timeout; the transaction's delete removes the row as matched.
</details>

<details><summary>Overlap with in-flight work</summary>

`git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head against #34439 (`7c80b9db`, shares `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`) and against branch `claude/issue-34412-before-hook-side-write-unit` (`320f1f86`, shares `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`): both clean, exit 0.
</details>
